description: Abstract class for parsing trace files, providing methods for decoding trace data, handling timestamps, and setting default proto fields.

classes.name: AbstractParser
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the Parser interface for trace files, providing core parsing logic and structure.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and decodes trace data, validates magic number, and extracts timestamps.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the trace type.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Returns descriptors for the trace file.

methods.name: getLengthEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of decoded trace entries.

methods.name: getTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves timestamps of a specific type.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Processes and returns a specific trace entry.

methods.name: addDefaultProtoFields
methods.description: Recursively adds default values to protocol buffer objects.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Abstract method to get the expected magic number for validation.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Abstract method to decode the trace buffer into entries.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Abstract method to extract timestamp from a decoded entry.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Abstract method to process a decoded entry into the desired format.
